theme: An open day against a few closing windows.
greeting: The calendar is empty today, Dan — a rare fully open Monday, with the girls at Jen's this stretch. What's pulling at the day isn't meetings but a cluster of trip-booking windows now days from closing.

needsAttention.title: December break trip
needsAttention.detail: The December shortlist was meant to be decided Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15 — that booking date is Wednesday, and six people across three holiday weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The full-size Portland SUV for Christmas has been the p1 'book this week' item since mid-September; a refundable hold costs nothing and it's the rental most likely to sell out over the holidays.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland-to-St-Pete drive is slotted into the Oct 5-18 off-week; the back half of that window is what's left to lock dates and the one hotel night.

flagged.title: Eugenia wants a date to talk
flagged.detail: She's back from Morocco Oct 31, says she's flexible, and asked you to pick a slot — the thread is resting on your reply.

flagged.title: Two senior roles in the alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn pushed a Citi MD and a capital-markets VP role overnight — automated alerts, not outreach, but in range.

flagged.title: Chase statement posted
flagged.detail: The Sapphire statement is ready with auto-pay already on — a glance, nothing owed.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters — Responsible Investor, WSJ, NYT Cooking, the St Pete local roundup, language nudges.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Deep autumn, with apples at their peak — a butterscotch tart is exactly the kind of from-scratch project this season rewards.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before noon — a genuinely clear stretch to start the week.
The day stays open straight through; no meetings bracket it on either side.
Tomorrow opens at 9 with an appointment, so an earlier night sets it up well.
